Plan a 3 day trip to Jaipur for my parents
2:11 AM

Here's a relaxed 3-day Jaipur plan with short walks and long rests for your parents.

Day 1, Old city: Hawa Mahal in the morning, then City Palace and Jantar Mantar. Rest after lunch, then take a slow evening stroll through Johari Bazaar.
Day 2, Forts: Amer Fort early, before the heat and crowds. Take a jeep up instead of walking the slope. Stop at Jal Mahal for photos, then watch the sunset at Nahargarh Fort.
Day 3, Easy day: Albert Hall Museum and Birla Mandir, then shop for block-print fabrics and jewellery. Finish with dal baati churma before you leave.

Late October onwards is pleasant weather. A hired car with a driver saves your parents a lot of walking, and a hotel near the old city keeps the daily travel short.

Find the opening hours of the National Museum in Delhi and the ticket price
2:15 AM

The National Museum, Janpath, New Delhi is open Tue to Fri, 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM, and Sat and Sun, 10:00 AM to 8:00 PM. It is closed on Mondays and national holidays. Today is Fri 23 Oct, so it closes at 6:00 PM; tomorrow, Sat 24 Oct, it is open 10:00 AM to 8:00 PM. Entry is ₹20 for adults, ₹500 for foreign nationals, and free for students up to class 12 with an ID card. Tickets can be booked on the museum's listed booking page. This is from the museum's own website.
